sloka: अथ स बलवृतः सवाहनस्त्रिदशपतिं परिगृह्य रावणिः ।स्वभवनमभिगम्य वीर्यवान्कृतसमरान्विससर्ज राक्षसान् ।। ७.२९.४२ ।।
transliteration: atha sa balavṛtaḥ savāhanastridaśapatiṁ parigṛhya rāvaṇiḥ ।svabhavanamabhigamya vīryavānkṛtasamarānvisasarja rākṣasān ।। 7.29.42 ।।

translations.english: Then, the valiant son of Ravana, Indrajit, having captured the lord of the gods along with his vehicles and surrounded by his army, returned to his own abode and dismissed the Rakshasas who had fought the battle.
